1	# Global Water Stress: Multi-Indicator Country Comparison
     2	
     3	## Overview
     4	Four datasets capture different dimensions of water stress for 10 countries spanning arid, semi-arid, and water-rich regions. Together they enable a composite view of regional water crisis severity.
     5	
     6	## Data Source
     7	
     8	### water_supply_demand
     9	Fields: `country` (string), `iso` (ISO 3166 alpha-3), `supply_demand_ratio` (float, renewable supply ÷ total withdrawal; values 0.31–6.12), `stress_class` (categorical: Extremely High / High / Medium-High / Medium / Low). Year: 2023 estimate.
    10	
    11	### per_capita_freshwater
    12	Fields: `country` (string), `per_capita_m3` (integer, cubic meters per person per year; range 84–80,620). Year: 2023 estimate. The 1,000 m³ threshold is commonly used to indicate water scarcity.
    13	
    14	### groundwater_extraction
    15	Fields: `country` (string), `extraction_km3_yr` (float, km³/year), `recharge_km3_yr` (float, km³/year), `extraction_recharge_ratio` (float; values 0.05–5.66). Ratio > 1.0 signals overdraft. Year: 2023 estimate.
    16	
    17	### precipitation_trends
    18	Fields: `country` (string), `decade` (categorical: 1990s / 2000s / 2010s), `mean_precip_mm` (integer, mm/year; range 41–1,761). Three decadal averages per country (30 rows total).
    19	
    20	## Data Notes
    21	- Supply-demand ratios are modeled estimates combining FAO AQUASTAT and WRI Aqueduct data.
    22	- Groundwater recharge estimates carry ±15% uncertainty in arid regions.
    23	- Precipitation values are country-wide spatial averages and mask sub-national variability.
    24	- Saudi Arabia's extremely high extraction-to-recharge ratio reflects reliance on non-renewable fossil aquifers.

1	# Mermaid.js Diagram Types
     2	
     3	Comprehensive syntax reference for all 24+ diagram types in Mermaid.js v11.
     4	
     5	## Core Diagrams
     6	
     7	### Flowchart
     8	Process flows, decision trees, workflows.
     9	
    10	**Syntax:**
    11	```
    12	flowchart {direction}
    13	  {nodeId}[{label}] {arrow} {nodeId}[{label}]
    14	```
    15	
    16	**Directions:** TB/TD (top-bottom), BT, LR (left-right), RL
    17	**Shapes:** `()` round, `[]` rect, `{}` diamond, `{{}}` hexagon, `(())` circle
    18	**Arrows:** `-->` solid, `-.->` dotted, `==>` thick
    19	**Subgraphs:** Group related nodes
    20	
    21	### Sequence Diagram
    22	Actor interactions, API flows, message sequences.
    23	
    24	**Syntax:**
    25	```
    26	sequenceDiagram
    27	  participant A as Actor
    28	  A->>B: Message
    29	  activate B
    30	  B-->>A: Response
    31	  deactivate B
    32	```
    33	
    34	**Arrows:** `->` solid, `->>` arrow, `-->` dotted, `-x` cross, `-)` async
    35	**Features:** Loops, alternatives, parallel, optional, critical regions
    36	
    37	### Class Diagram
    38	OOP structures, inheritance, relationships.
    39	
    40	**Syntax:**
    41	```
    42	classDiagram
    43	  class Animal {
    44	    +String name
    45	    -int age
    46	    +void eat()
    47	  }
    48	  Animal <|-- Dog : inherits
    49	```
    50	
    51	**Visibility:** `+` public, `-` private, `#` protected, `~` package
    52	**Relationships:** `<|--` inheritance, `*--` composition, `o--` aggregation, `-->` association
    53	
    54	### State Diagram
    55	State machines, transitions, workflows.
    56	
    57	**Syntax:**
    58	```
    59	stateDiagram-v2
    60	  [*] --> State1
    61	  State1 --> State2 : transition
    62	  State2 --> [*]
    63	```
    64	
    65	**Features:** Composite states, choice points, forks/joins, concurrency
    66	
    67	### ER Diagram
    68	Database relationships, schemas.
    69	
    70	**Syntax:**
    71	```
    72	erDiagram
    73	  CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places
    74	  ORDER ||--|{ LINE_ITEM : contains
    75	```
    76	
    77	**Cardinality:** `||` one, `|o` zero-one, `}|` one-many, `}o` zero-many

    91	    Task2 :active, after Task1, 3d

1	# Mermaid.js Configuration & Theming
     2	
     3	Configuration options, theming, and customization for Mermaid.js v11.
     4	
     5	## Configuration Methods
     6	
     7	**1. Site-wide Initialization:**
     8	```javascript
     9	mermaid.initialize({
    10	  theme: 'dark',
    11	  startOnLoad: true,
    12	  securityLevel: 'strict',
    13	  fontFamily: 'Arial'
    14	});
    15	```
    16	
    17	**2. Diagram-level Frontmatter:**
    18	````markdown
    19	```mermaid
    20	---
    21	theme: forest
    22	look: handDrawn
    23	---
    24	flowchart TD
    25	  A --> B
    26	```
    27	````
    28	
    29	**3. Configuration Hierarchy:**
    30	Default config → Site config → Diagram config (highest priority)
    31	
    32	## Core Options
    33	
    34	**Rendering:**
    35	- `startOnLoad`: Auto-render on page load (default: true)
    36	- `securityLevel`: "strict" (default), "loose", "antiscript", "sandbox"
    37	- `deterministicIds`: Reproducible SVG IDs (default: false)
    38	- `maxTextSize`: Max diagram text (default: 50000)
    39	- `maxEdges`: Max drawable edges (default: 500)
    40	
    41	**Visual Style:**
    42	- `look`: "classic" (default), "handDrawn"
    43	- `handDrawnSeed`: Numeric seed for hand-drawn consistency
    44	- `darkMode`: Boolean toggle
    45	
    46	**Typography:**
    47	- `fontFamily`: "trebuchet ms, verdana, arial, sans-serif" (default)
    48	- `fontSize`: Base text size (default: 16)
    49	
    50	**Layout:**
    51	- `layout`: "dagre" (default), "elk", "tidy-tree", "cose-bilkent"
    52	
    53	**Debug:**
    54	- `logLevel`: 0-5 from trace to fatal
    55	- `htmlLabels`: Enable HTML in labels (default: false)
    56	
    57	## Theming
    58	
    59	**Built-in Themes:**
    60	- `default` - Standard colors
    61	- `dark` - Dark background
    62	- `forest` - Green tones
    63	- `neutral` - Grayscale
    64	- `base` - Fully customizable
    65	
    66	**Theme Variables (base theme only):**
    67	```javascript
    68	mermaid.initialize({
    69	  theme: 'base',
    70	  themeVariables: {
    71	    primaryColor: '#ff0000',
    72	    primaryTextColor: '#fff',
    73	    primaryBorderColor: '#7C0000',
    74	    secondaryColor: '#006100',
    75	    tertiaryColor: '#fff'
    76	  }
    77	});
    78	```
    79	
    80	**Customizable Variables:**
    81	- Color families: primary, secondary, tertiary
    82	- Node backgrounds and text colors
    83	- Border and line colors
    84	- Note background/text
    85	- Diagram-specific (flowchart nodes, sequence actors, pie sections)
    86	
    87	**Custom CSS:**
    88	```javascript
    89	mermaid.initialize({
    90	  themeCSS: `
    91	    .node rect { fill: #f9f; }
    92	    .edgeLabel { background-color: white; }
    93	  `
    94	});
    95	```
    96	
    97	## Accessibility
    98	
    99	**ARIA Support:**
   100	```
   101	accTitle: Diagram Title
   102	accDescr: Brief description
   103	accDescr {
   104	  Multi-line detailed
   105	  description
   106	}
   107	```
   108	
   109	**Auto-generated:**
   110	- `aria-roledescription` attributes
   111	- `<title>` and `<desc>` SVG elements
   112	- `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby`
   113	
   114	**WCAG Compliance:**
   115	Available for all diagram types (flowchart, sequence, class, Gantt, etc.)
   116	
   117	## Icon Configuration
   118	
   119	**Register Icon Packs:**
   120	```javascript
   121	import { registerIconPacks } from 'mermaid';
   122	registerIconPacks([
   123	  {
   124	    name: 'logos',
   125	    loader: () => import('https://esm.run/@iconify-json/logos')
   126	  }
   127	]);
   128	```
   129	
   130	**Usage:**
   131	```
   132	architecture-beta
   133	  service api(logos:nodejs)[API]
   134	```
   135	
   136	**Loading Methods:**
   137	1. CDN-based (lazy loading)
   138	2. npm with dynamic import
   139	3. Direct import
   140	
   141	## Math Rendering
   142	
   143	**KaTeX Support:**
   144	```
   145	graph LR
   146	  A["$$f(x) = x^2$$"] --> B
   147	```
   148	
   149	**Configuration:**
   150	- `legacyMathML`: Use old MathML rendering
   151	- `forceLegacyMathML`: Force legacy even if browser supports native
   152	
   153	## Security
   154	
   155	**Security Levels:**
   156	- `strict` - HTML encoding (default, recommended)
   157	- `loose` - Some HTML allowed
   158	- `antiscript` - Filter scripts
   159	- `sandbox` - Sandboxed mode
   160	
   161	**DOMPurify:**
   162	Enabled by default for XSS protection. Customize via `dompurifyConfig` (use caution).
   163	
   164	## Layout Algorithms
   165	
   166	**dagre (default):**
   167	Standard hierarchical layout for most diagrams.
   168	
   169	**elk:**
   170	Advanced layout with better handling of complex graphs.
   171	
   172	**tidy-tree:**
   173	Clean tree structures for hierarchies.
   174	
   175	**cose-bilkent:**
   176	Compound graph layout for nested structures.
   177	
   178	**Per-diagram Configuration:**
   179	````markdown
   180	```mermaid
   181	---
   182	layout: elk
   183	---
   184	flowchart TD
   185	  A --> B
   186	```
   187	````
   188	
   189	## Common Patterns
   190	
   191	**Consistent Hand-drawn Style:**
   192	```javascript
   193	mermaid.initialize({
   194	  look: 'handDrawn',
   195	  handDrawnSeed: 42  // Same seed = consistent appearance
   196	});
   197	```
   198	
   199	**Dark Mode Toggle:**
   200	```javascript
   201	const isDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
   202	mermaid.initialize({
   203	  theme: isDark ? 'dark' : 'default'
   204	});
   205	```
   206	
   207	**Performance Optimization:**
   208	```javascript
   209	mermaid.initialize({
   210	  startOnLoad: false,  // Manual rendering
   211	  maxEdges: 1000,       // Increase for complex graphs
   212	  deterministicIds: true  // Caching-friendly
   213	});
   214	```
   215	
   216	## Validation
   217	
   218	**Parse without Rendering:**
   219	```javascript
   220	try {
   221	  await mermaid.parse('graph TD\nA-->B');
   222	  console.log('Valid syntax');
   223	} catch(e) {
   224	  console.error('Invalid:', e);
   225	}
   226	```
   227	
   228	**Programmatic Rendering:**
   229	```javascript
   230	const { svg } = await mermaid.render('graphId', 'graph TD\nA-->B');
   231	document.getElementById('output').innerHTML = svg;
   232	```

1	# Mermaid.js CLI Usage
     2	
     3	Command-line interface for converting Mermaid diagrams to SVG/PNG/PDF.
     4	
     5	## Installation
     6	
     7	**Global Install:**
     8	```bash
     9	npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli
    10	```
    11	
    12	**Local Install:**
    13	```bash
    14	npm install @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli
    15	./node_modules/.bin/mmdc -h
    16	```
    17	
    18	**No Install (npx):**
    19	```bash
    20	npx -p @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli mmdc -h
    21	```
    22	
    23	**Docker:**
    24	```bash
    25	docker pull ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli
    26	```
    27	
    28	**Requirements:** Node.js ^18.19 || >=20.0
    29	
    30	## Basic Commands
    31	
    32	**Convert to SVG:**
    33	```bash
    34	mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.svg
    35	```
    36	
    37	**Convert to PNG:**
    38	```bash
    39	mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.png
    40	```
    41	
    42	**Convert to PDF:**
    43	```bash
    44	mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.pdf
    45	```
    46	
    47	Output format determined by file extension.
    48	
    49	## CLI Flags
    50	
    51	**Core Options:**
    52	- `-i, --input <file>` - Input file (use `-` for stdin)
    53	- `-o, --output <file>` - Output file path
    54	- `-t, --theme <name>` - Theme: default, dark, forest, neutral
    55	- `-b, --background <color>` - Background: transparent, white, #hex
    56	- `--cssFile <file>` - Custom CSS for styling
    57	- `--configFile <file>` - Mermaid configuration file
    58	- `-h, --help` - Show all options
    59	
    60	**Example with All Options:**
    61	```bash
    62	mmdc -i diagram.mmd -o output.png \
    63	  -t dark \
    64	  -b transparent \
    65	  --cssFile custom.css \
    66	  --configFile mermaid-config.json
    67	```
    68	
    69	## Advanced Usage
    70	
    71	**Stdin Piping:**
    72	```bash
    73	cat diagram.mmd | mmdc --input - -o output.svg
    74	
    75	# Or inline
    76	cat << EOF | mmdc --input - -o output.svg
    77	graph TD
    78	  A[Start] --> B[End]
    79	EOF
    80	```
    81	
    82	**Batch Processing:**
    83	```bash
    84	for file in *.mmd; do
    85	  mmdc -i "$file" -o "${file%.mmd}.svg"
    86	done
    87	```
    88	
    89	**Markdown Files:**
    90	Process markdown with embedded diagrams:
    91	```bash
    92	mmdc -i README.template.md -o README.md
    93	```
    94	
    95	## Docker Workflows
    96	
    97	**Basic Docker Usage:**
    98	```bash
    99	docker run --rm \
   100	  -u $(id -u):$(id -g) \
   101	  -v /path/to/diagrams:/data \
   102	  ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli \
   103	  -i diagram.mmd -o output.svg
   104	```
   105	
   106	**Mount Working Directory:**
   107	```bash
   108	docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/data \
   109	  ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli \
   110	  -i /data/input.mmd -o /data/output.png
   111	```
   112	
   113	**Podman (with SELinux):**
   114	```bash
   115	podman run --userns keep-id --user ${UID} \
   116	  --rm -v /path/to/diagrams:/data:z \
   117	  ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli \
   118	  -i diagram.mmd
   119	```
   120	
   121	## Configuration Files
   122	
   123	**Mermaid Config (JSON):**
   124	```json
   125	{
   126	  "theme": "dark",
   127	  "look": "handDrawn",
   128	  "fontFamily": "Arial",
   129	  "flowchart": {
   130	    "curve": "basis"
   131	  }
   132	}
   133	```
   134	
   135	**Usage:**
   136	```bash
   137	mmdc -i input.mmd --configFile config.json -o output.svg
   138	```
   139	
   140	**Custom CSS:**
   141	```css
   142	.node rect {
   143	  fill: #f9f;
   144	  stroke: #333;
   145	}
   146	.edgeLabel {
   147	  background-color: white;
   148	}
   149	```
   150	
   151	**Usage:**
   152	```bash
   153	mmdc -i input.mmd --cssFile styles.css -o output.svg
   154	```
   155	
   156	## Node.js API
   157	
   158	**Programmatic Usage:**
   159	```javascript
   160	import { run } from '@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli';
   161	
   162	await run('input.mmd', 'output.svg', {
   163	  theme: 'dark',
   164	  backgroundColor: 'transparent'
   165	});
   166	```
   167	
   168	**With Options:**
   169	```javascript
   170	import { run } from '@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli';
   171	
   172	await run('diagram.mmd', 'output.png', {
   173	  theme: 'forest',
   174	  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
   175	  cssFile: 'custom.css',
   176	  configFile: 'config.json'
   177	});
   178	```
   179	
   180	## Common Workflows
   181	
   182	**Documentation Generation:**
   183	```bash
   184	# Convert all diagrams in docs/
   185	find docs/ -name "*.mmd" -exec sh -c \
   186	  'mmdc -i "$1" -o "${1%.mmd}.svg"' _ {} \;
   187	```
   188	
   189	**Styled Output:**
   190	```bash
   191	# Create dark-themed transparent diagrams
   192	mmdc -i architecture.mmd -o arch.png \
   193	  -t dark \
   194	  -b transparent \
   195	  --cssFile animations.css
   196	```
   197	
   198	**CI/CD Pipeline:**
   199	```yaml
   200	# GitHub Actions example
   201	- name: Generate Diagrams
   202	  run: |
   203	    npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli
   204	    mmdc -i docs/diagram.mmd -o docs/diagram.svg

   208	```bash

   211	```
   212	
   213	## Troubleshooting

import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Extract datasets
supply_demand = {d['country']: d for d in data['water_supply_demand']['data']}
per_capita = {d['country']: d for d in data['per_capita_freshwater']['data']}
groundwater = {d['country']: d for d in data['groundwater_extraction']['data']}
precip = {d['country']: d for d in data['precipitation_trends']['data']}

# Compute precipitation trends (slope of decadal means)
precip_trends = {}
for country in supply_demand:
    vals = [p['mean_precip_mm'] for p in data['precipitation_trends']['data'] if p['country'] == country]
    decades = [0, 1, 2]
    slope = np.polyfit(decades, vals, 1)[0]
    precip_trends[country] = slope

# Sort countries by supply-demand ratio (ascending = most stressed first)
countries = sorted(supply_demand.keys(), key=lambda c: supply_demand[c]['supply_demand_ratio'])

# Stress class color mapping
stress_colors = {
    'Extremely High': '#B2182B',  # dark crimson
    'High': '#D6604D',            # red-orange
    'Medium-High': '#F4A582',     # light orange
    'Medium': '#4393C3',          # blue
    'Low': '#2166AC',             # dark blue
}

# Create figure with 2 subplots sharing y-axis
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 10), sharey=True,
                                gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1.2, 1], 'wspace': 0.08})

y_pos = np.arange(len(countries))
bar_height = 0.6

# ===================== LEFT PANEL =====================
# Supply-Demand Ratio bars
sd_ratios = [supply_demand[c]['supply_demand_ratio'] for c in countries]
sd_colors = [stress_colors[supply_demand[c]['stress_class']] for c in countries]

bars1 = ax1.barh(y_pos, sd_ratios, height=bar_height, color=sd_colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)

# Add value labels on bars
for i, (bar, val) in enumerate(zip(bars1, sd_ratios)):
    ax1.text(val + 0.05, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:.2f}',
             va='center', ha='left', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

# Critical threshold line at 1.0
ax1.axvline(x=1.0, color='#444444', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, zorder=4, alpha=0.8)
ax1.text(1.0, len(countries) - 0.3, 'Demand = Supply', ha='center', va='bottom',
         fontsize=9, color='#444444', fontstyle='italic')

# Groundwater extraction/recharge ratio overlay (scatter on bars)
gw_ratios = [groundwater[c]['extraction_recharge_ratio'] for c in countries]
# Scale marker size by absolute extraction
extractions = [groundwater[c]['extraction_km3_yr'] for c in countries]
min_ext, max_ext = min(extractions), max(extractions)
marker_sizes = [50 + 250 * (e - min_ext) / (max_ext - min_ext) for e in extractions]

# Color: red for overdraft (>1.0), gray for sustainable
gw_colors = ['#E41A1C' if r > 1.0 else '#666666' for r in gw_ratios]
ax1.scatter(gw_ratios, y_pos, s=marker_sizes, c=gw_colors, edgecolors='white', linewidths=1.5,
            zorder=5, alpha=0.9)

# GW ratio labels
for i, (val, color) in enumerate(zip(gw_ratios, gw_colors)):
    ax1.text(val, y_pos[i] + 0.28, f'{val:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom',
             fontsize=7, color=color, fontweight='bold')

ax1.set_xlabel('Supply-to-Demand Ratio (dimensionless)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')
ax1.set_title('Water Supply vs. Demand & Groundwater Sustainability', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.set_xlim(0, 7.5)
ax1.invert_yaxis()

# ===================== RIGHT PANEL =====================
pc_values = [per_capita[c]['per_capita_m3'] for c in countries]
# Use log scale for per-capita to show orders of magnitude
pc_log = np.log10(pc_values)

# Color bars by value: gradient from dark red (low) to blue (high)
norm = plt.Normalize(min(pc_log), max(pc_log))
cmap = plt.cm.RdYlBu
colors_pc = [cmap(norm(v)) for v in pc_log]

bars2 = ax2.barh(y_pos, pc_values, height=bar_height, color=colors_pc, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)

# Add value labels
for i, (bar, val) in enumerate(zip(bars2, pc_values)):
    ax2.text(val + 500, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:,}',
             va='center', ha='left', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

# Water scarcity threshold line at 1000 m³
ax2.axvline(x=1000, color='#B2182B', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, zorder=4, alpha=0.8)
ax2.text(1000, len(countries) - 0.3, 'Scarcity Threshold (1,000 m³)', ha='center', va='bottom',
         fontsize=9, color='#B2182B', fontstyle='italic')

ax2.set_xlabel('Per-Capita Freshwater (m³/person/year, log-scale implied)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')
ax2.set_title('Per-Capita Renewable Freshwater Availability', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.set_xlim(0, 95000)
ax2.set_xscale('linear')  # linear but annotations show magnitude

# ===================== Y-AXIS LABELS WITH PRECIPITATION TRENDS =====================
# Custom y-tick labels with precipitation trend arrows
ytick_labels = []
for c in countries:
    slope = precip_trends[c]
    if slope < -5:
        arrow = '▼'  # strong decrease
        arrow_color = '#B2182B'
    elif slope < 0:
        arrow = '↓'  # decrease
        arrow_color = '#D6604D'
    elif slope > 5:
        arrow = '▲'  # strong increase
        arrow_color = '#2166AC'
    else:
        arrow = '↑'  # increase
        arrow_color = '#4393C3'
    
    ytick_labels.append(f'{arrow}  {c}')

ax1.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax1.set_yticklabels(ytick_labels, fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# Color the y-tick labels by precipitation trend
for i, label in enumerate(ax1.get_yticklabels()):
    slope = precip_trends[countries[i]]
    if slope < 0:
        label.set_color('#B2182B')
    else:
        label.set_color('#2166AC')

# ===================== LEGENDS =====================
# Stress class legend
stress_legend = [mpatches.Patch(color=stress_colors[k], label=k) for k in 
                 ['Extremely High', 'High', 'Medium-High', 'Medium', 'Low']]
legend1 = ax1.legend(handles=stress_legend, title='Water Stress Class', loc='lower right',
                     fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10, frameon=True, fancybox=True, shadow=False,
                     edgecolor='#cccccc')

# Groundwater legend
gw_legend = [
    plt.scatter([], [], s=80, c='#E41A1C', edgecolors='white', linewidths=1.5, label='Overdraft (>1.0)'),
    plt.scatter([], [], s=80, c='#666666', edgecolors='white', linewidths=1.5, label='Sustainable (≤1.0)'),
]
legend2 = ax1.legend(handles=gw_legend, title='Groundwater Extraction/Recharge', loc='upper right',
                     fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10, frameon=True, fancybox=True, shadow=False,
                     edgecolor='#cccccc')
ax1.add_artist(legend1)

# Precipitation trend legend
precip_legend = [
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='▼', color='w', markerfacecolor='#B2182B', markersize=10, label='Declining Precipitation'),
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='↑', color='w', markerfacecolor='#2166AC', markersize=10, label='Increasing Precipitation'),
]
legend3 = ax2.legend(handles=precip_legend, title='Decadal Precipitation Trend (1990s→2010s)', loc='upper right',
                     fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10, frameon=True, fancybox=True, shadow=False,
                     edgecolor='#cccccc')

# ===================== ANNOTATIONS & TITLES =====================
fig.suptitle('Global Water Stress: Multi-Indicator Country Comparison (2023 Estimates)',
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98, color='#1a1a1a')

# Subtitle
fig.text(0.5, 0.935, 'Countries ranked by supply-to-demand ratio. Groundwater sustainability and precipitation trends reveal converging crisis hotspots.',
         ha='center', fontsize=11, color='#555555', style='italic')

# Source note
fig.text(0.5, 0.02, 'Data: FAO AQUASTAT / WRI Aqueduct modeled estimates (2023).  Groundwater recharge ±15% uncertainty in arid regions.  Precipitation: country-wide spatial averages.',
         ha='center', fontsize=8, color='#888888')

# ===================== STYLING =====================
for ax in (ax1, ax2):
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['left'].set_color('#cccccc')
    ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#cccccc')
    ax.tick_params(colors='#555555')
    ax.grid(axis='x', linestyle='-', alpha=0.15, color='#555555', zorder=0)
    ax.set_facecolor('#fafafa')

fig.patch.set_facecolor('#ffffff')

# Highlight critical countries with a subtle background
for i, c in enumerate(countries):
    if supply_demand[c]['stress_class'] == 'Extremely High':
        ax1.axhspan(i - 0.5, i + 0.5, color='#FFF5F0', alpha=0.5, zorder=0)
        ax2.axhspan(i - 0.5, i + 0.5, color='#FFF5F0', alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.04, 1, 0.92])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')
